description: Dilution snapshot header (the largest dilution payload): summary totals (potential new shares, their % of shares outstanding, per-family totals), the cash position (anchor cash, monthly burn, estimated current cash, runway months), the float block, and `meta` provenance. Instrument rows are not included. Cash is in the filer's reporting currency: `cashPosition.currency` is ISO 4217 (null = not determined), and `cashPosition.currencySource: "presumed_usd"` is a presumption, not a measurement. Runway months are currency-neutral. Float: a non-null `floatWithheldReason` means the tradeable float was not measured, and no float figure is stated. A declined float block (`available: false`) may carry `refusal.withheldReason`, the same value the standalone float data serves. `tradeableFloatCeiling` is an upper bound, not a float: the float is at most that figure, and the ceiling is not an input to a market capitalisation, percent-of-float, short-interest ratio or comparison. Bounded totals: a null total (`potentialNewShares`, `totalWarrantShares`, `totalConvertibleShares`, `totalEquityPlanShares`, `totalExchangeableShares`, `totalRightsShares`, `potentialDilutionPercent`) may sit beside `<key>Bound: "ceiling"`, `<key>Ceiling` and `<key>Floor`: the total is at most the ceiling, the floor is the measured part, and the ceiling is not the total. With `potentialDilutionPercentBoundReason: "stated_count_denominator"` there is no floor: the ceiling divides by the last stated share count (as of `potentialDilutionPercentCeilingShareCountAsOf`), so the figure is at most that percentage against the count stated as of that date. Approximate totals: `<total>Approximate: true` (e.g. `potentialNewSharesApproximate`, `potentialDilutionPercentApproximate`, `totalWarrantSharesApproximate`) means that total includes an issuer-stated approximate count ("approximately 16.1 million shares"): state it as approximately / ≈ that figure, never as exact. `statedCountSizedRows[]` lists every row sized from its own cited filing text (rule, shares, approximate, quote, accession). `notMeasuredReasons[]` ({field, code, text, detail, expected {form, dueDate, status}}) gives the reason a figure is null; it is an explanation, not a value. `expectedFilings[]` lists the next periodic report(s): `status: "late"` means due by `dueDate` with none on file as of `checkedOn` and carries no information about why; `dueDate: null` means not computed. A `kind: "annual_meeting"` row (Nasdaq 5620(a) / NYSE 302.00) with status "late" means no 8-K Item 5.07 vote results are on file, not that a meeting was missed. SPAC rights: `totalRightsShares` (present only when the snapshot examined rights) is the shares delivered to holders of SPAC unit rights on the initial business combination; it is included in `potentialNewShares`, and the rights lapse if no combination closes. `rightsOverlapWarrantRows` > 0 means a warrant row also names rights, so the rights total and the headline are withheld (null) rather than counted twice. A runway figure beside `goingConcern: true` is a contradiction the auditors flagged: the going-concern doubt qualifies the runway. Returns HTTP 200 for unavailable data; the `available` and `reason` fields say why. `not_covered` means this company has not been analysed yet, not that it has no dilution; an outage is a 5xx. A null, absent or withheld value means the figure was not measured; it does not mean "no dilution", "no warrants", "no shelf" or zero. A numeric 0 is a measured zero, so availability is carried by the availability, withheld and reason fields, not by the value. Figures are as of `meta.asOfDate`, from filings read through `meta.filingsThrough` (a stale date predates anything filed since). Share counts are on one split basis; a row that cannot be rebased is omitted and counted rather than published on a mixed basis. Included in Signal8 Pro: without it the call returns 403 FEATURE_NOT_AVAILABLE with `requiredTier: "pro"` (a tier upgrade; there is no add-on to buy).
name: get_dilution_snapshot
title: Get Dilution Snapshot Summary
